notes: Every zone now has exactly 5 bosses. Heartfall Belfry gets its 5th boss: Nocturna, the Moonveil Moth.
Nocturna is a huge shadow moth with glowing yellow eyes, feathery antennae and four stained-glass wings. Her upper wings have heart-shaped eyespots and her lower wings have crescent moons.
Wing Gust: she spreads her wings and blows a fan of wind lanes at you. The lanes are marked before they hit.
Heart-Moon Eclipse: a glowing heart-moon falls where you stand. Get out of the marked circle before it lands, then dodge the ring of moonlight it sends out.
Lullaby: a music-box tune plays while she sends out slow rings of moonlight. Each ring is offset from the last, so look for the gaps.
Moonveil: she breaks apart into a swarm of moths and comes back together near you. Where she will land is marked first, and she sends out a ring of moonlight when she does.
Below half health her wings flare with moonlight. She attacks more often, her attacks get bigger, and moondust drops in small marked circles around you.
When she dies, her body fades into the dark and she breaks apart into a cloud of small glowing moths that fly away.
She has her own sounds: fluttering wings, a music-box lullaby and the rising swell of the eclipse.

Heartfall Belfry bosses: the Grand Clockwarden, Heartmaw, the Stainglass Seraph, the Keybearer Shade and Nocturna, the Moonveil Moth. She is part of the Belfry's shuffled rotation, so you meet all 5 before any boss repeats.
Nocturna is as tough as the other Belfry bosses.
No class, gear or save data has changed.
